definitions.explanation: Two weeks from the current week.

examples.japanese: {再来週|さらいしゅう}の{月曜日|げつようび}に{会|あ}いましょう。
examples.english: Let's meet on Monday the week after next.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}は{再来週|さらいしゅう}です。
examples.english: The exam is the week after next.

notes: Time reference sequence: {先週|せんしゅう} (last week) → {今週|こんしゅう} (this week) → {来週|らいしゅう} (next week) → {再来週|さらいしゅう} (week after next).
